description: Read-only Ethernet diagnostics, gateway checks and local network discovery for CardputerZero

store.summary: Read-only Ethernet diagnostics, gateway checks and local device discovery.
store.description: Ethernet Tester provides read-only diagnostics for eth0: link state, speed and duplex, available interface counters, IPv4/MAC/gateway and DNS configuration, driver metadata, and current systemd-networkd DHCP lease details where supported. It can send one ping to the configured gateway and show a snapshot of cumulative interface counters; this is not a throughput test. On explicit user action, it can scan the local IPv4 subnet with arp-scan, browse mDNS/DNS-SD services, or make one PTR lookup for the gateway. Separate passive views listen for LLDP/CDP switch announcements and ARP, DHCP and STP frames; no packet capture is saved. The package grants cap_net_raw to the executable for passive listening. The app does not configure the interface, renew DHCP, or request CAP_NET_ADMIN.
